changeSet.author: archiv
changeSet.sql: alter table dokument add column dateiname text null constraint dokument_dateiname_ck check (dateiname is null or char_length(dateiname) between 1 and 255)

create function archiv_dateiname_text(n text) returns text language sql immutable parallel safe as $$ select coalesce(translate(regexp_replace(n, '(?<=.)\.(?=[0-9]*[A-Za-z])[0-9A-Za-z]{1,5}$', ''), '_-.', ' '), '') $$

alter table dokument alter column volltext_tsv set expression as ( setweight(to_tsvector('german'::regconfig, coalesce(titel, '')), 'A') || setweight(to_tsvector('german'::regconfig, coalesce(partner_name, '')), 'B') || setweight(to_tsvector('german'::regconfig, archiv_tags_text(tags)), 'B') || setweight(to_tsvector('german'::regconfig, coalesce(volltext, '')), 'C') || setweight(to_tsvector('german'::regconfig, archiv_dateiname_text(dateiname)), 'D'))
